about.en: BlackBerry bStock (BBB) is a tokenized share of BlackBerry Limited issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate, under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain, backed 1:1 by BB shares held with a regulated custodian and convertible 1:1 into the underlying equity, and it passes through the price movements and dividend adjustments of that share. bStocks are admitted to trading under prospectuses approved by the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority and are not offered in every jurisdiction.
